messages:
maria: Kicking off a sequenced release that touches router, runtime, and console. Change window 00:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: 3 waves, perf guardrails, pinned runtime kernel for v2.
sean: Quick Q — which exact versions are we pinning? Need the image tags to add to the rollout docs.
maria: Router -> router:v2.1.0, Runtime -> runtime:2026-03-kernelA, Console -> console:3.4.1. I'll paste the exact deploybot commands below.
katie: Console migration note: schema flag `console-toggle` will need to be flipped in wave 2; DevEx page updated? If schema mismatch, UI errors likely.
maria: Right — schema flip planned wave 2. Wave sizes: 1=1%, 2=25%, 3=100%. Roll forward gating between waves is 20m stable with no critical alerts.
sean: Rollback criteria proposal: if p95 latency increases > 150ms sustained for 10m OR error rate > 0.8% for 5m, auto-fail wave and rollback to previous router:v2.0.8.
infra-shephard: Add resource OOMs to the list — any JVM OOM or runtime GPU OOM should trigger immediate rollback. Also monitor KV cache miss rate; that caused prior regressions.
maria: Agreed. I'll add OOM and KV-miss > 3x baseline for 10m as triggers. Also keep a manual hold option.
deploybot: deploybot: wave 1 scheduled at 2026-03-25T00:10:00Z. Commands queued:
```
# pin the router instance group
deploybot pin --service router --version router:v2.1.0 --change-window 00:00-02:00
# reserve runtime pool with kernelA
deploybot reserve --service runtime --kernel kernelA --capacity 50
```
```logs
deploybot: queued wave 1 -> job 64211
```

katie: Who's owning post-wave smoke? I can take the console/UI checks for wave 1 and 2.
sean: I'll watch API and runtime traces, set up trace-sampling to 100% for first 5m of each wave.
maria: I'll take router and traffic-shift. @infra-shephard please keep an eye on infra alarms and be ready to open the rollback channel.
infra-shephard: Oncall will be monitoring. I'll post alerts in #incidents if thresholds trip.
dev-ex-bot: DevEx docs updated: https://redwood.devex/release-notes/2026-03-25-sequenced-rollout. Added pin commands and rollback checklist.
maria: Release notes updated in PR #4822. Reminder: change log must mention console-toggle and kernel pin.
sean: Preflight checklist before wave 1:
- confirm deploybot pins applied
- confirm runtime pool reserved
- tracing and metrics turned up
- canary GA test run
katie: I'll run quick UI smoke: login, embedding flow, settings page.
maria: If all green, wave 2 scheduled +25% at 00:40. If any gate fails, we rollback to router:v2.0.8 and unpin kernel.
sean: ack. I'll have alert thresholds in an Ops runbook snippet: `p95>150ms @10m`, `error_rate>0.8% @5m`, `OOM detected immediate`.
maria: Final note: update release-notes with rollback rationale and contact list. Ping once wave 1 completes with timestamps.
deploybot: deploybot: wave 1 executed at 2026-03-25T00:10:12Z. Canary instances: 12. Pin confirmations: router pinned, runtime reserved.
katie: wave1 smoke done. UI flows ok. No console errors seen.
sean: traces look clean, p95 unchanged, error rate 0.05%. No OOMs.
infra-shephard: infra healthy. KV miss spike at +10% transient for 2m then normalized.
maria: Good. Scheduling wave 2 now. wave 2 start ~2026-03-25T00:40:00Z.
sean: leaving 5m elevated trace sampling for wave 2 too.
katie: I'll be ready for schema flip watch during wave 2.
maria: thumbs up. If anything fuzzy, hit :rotating_light: and we stop traffic shift and rollback. Otherwise final wave later tonight.
sean: 👍
katie: :thumbsup:
